reviews.comment: Professor Kilpatrick is supportive and provides many resources for success. Assignments are varied, quizzes are open-book, and quantitative work includes detailed examples. Instructions are very clear, extra credit is available, and academic integrity policies are strongly enforced.

She was a great professor! No exams in the class and just a few projects, so it was extremely manageable. There was a semester-long project where you had to take pictures of different insects, but she organized a lot of field trips at different times throughout the semester and gave a huge list of local locations you could go to to find insects.
